Messages.Author: Thomas Stellmach
Messages.Body:
Two Questions:
1) Vamp A is in combat and uses Blur for additional strikes. Is it possible
for him to use sup. Acrobatics for the dodge effect (add. add. strike
fizzles)?

2) Blocking Vampire of Meth. A plays Burst of Sunlight / Rötschreck in
combat against the acting vampire of Meth. B. Can Meth C play Rötschreck to
affect the Vampire of Meth A?

Thank you, Thomas Stellmach

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Thomas Stellmach wrote:
>
> Two Questions:
>
> 1) Vamp A is in combat and uses Blur for additional strikes. Is it possible
> for him to use sup. Acrobatics for the dodge effect (add. add. strike
> fizzles)?
No. Can only use 1 additional-strike-gainer each round.

> 2) Blocking Vampire of Meth. A plays Burst of Sunlight / Rötschreck in
> combat against the acting vampire of Meth. B. Can Meth C play Rötschreck to
> affect the Vampire of Meth A?

No. After the first R., combat is over.

>
> Maybe I'm just thick-skulled but just as Psyche! interrupts Rotschreck, why

After the first R., that timing window is passed.
